title: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report — the Columbus Day shift: Thursday 12:00 p.m. ET, data for the week ending 2026-10-09, published the day the Saudi East-West repair window closes
source: EST: eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/schedule.php, fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 52,322 bytes). This date is NOT rule-derived — it is a verbatim row of the publisher's own Holiday Release Schedule table, which reads `October 9, 2026 | October 15, 2026 | Thursday | 12:00 p.m. | Columbus Day` across its five columns (Data for the week ending / Alternate release date / Release day / Release time / Holiday). That is the STRONGEST date evidence any WPSR entry on this calendar carries: a named date AND a named time, published by EIA itself, against the sibling entries' cadence-plus-weekday derivation. Filed `estimate` on ONE count and it is a schema gap, not date doubt: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy defines no `EIA:` prefix, the same gap eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-16, eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-30 and every eia-steo-* entry already record. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: DISCOVERED IN THE eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-30 never-assessed ADJACENCY SWEEP (2026-09-15), off the same primary schedule page that dates the proposer. PROPOSED AGAINST A BAR A SIBLING LANE SET AND THIS ONE CLEARS, which is why it is filed and 09-23 and 10-07 are not: eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-16's own sweep declined to propose the 09-23 weekly because its corridor carried no energy hook, and wrote down that 'if a 10-01-style energy hook appears, the lane that finds it should file it THEN, with the hook as the reason.' THE HOOK: 2026-10-15 is the date this calendar already tracks as saudi-east-west-pipeline-repair-window-close-2026-10-15 (medium, estimate) — the outer bound of the officials' 3-5 week repair window on the 7 mb/d line whose 2026-09-11 shutdown is the single event every energy ledger on this calendar is scoped to. A US inventory print and the regime-ending deadline land on the SAME DAY, and the print lands at an off-cadence 12:00 ET rather than 10:30, which is exactly the shape that breaks an automated attribution. SECOND HOOK: the corridor is unusually loud for a weekly — cpi-2026-10-14 (confirmed, high), retail-sales-2026-10-15 (confirmed, high), ppi-2026-10-15 (confirmed, medium), beige-book-2026-10-14, opex-2026-10-16, fomc-blackout-start-2026-10-17. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is tiered low on the same grounds as its proposer: no house playbook is energy-keyed, no tracked symbol carries direct crude exposure, `symbols` is empty on purpose, and an ordinary weekly inventory print is inert tape. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Full proposer ledger: docs/research/events/eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-30.md.
